title: Four leadership styles
caption: No style is best everywhere: the situation drives the choice. The same leader might tell everyone to leave in a fire alarm and let the team agree its own bank holiday rota.
alt: Four boxes: autocratic, democratic, laissez-faire and paternalistic, each with its strength and weakness.
description: Autocratic: the leader decides and tells; fast and clear, but can demotivate skilled staff.
Democratic: the leader involves staff; builds commitment, but slower.
Laissez-faire: decisions left to the group; suits skilled experts, often leads to drift.
Paternalistic: the leader decides in what they see as staff's best interests; builds loyalty, can feel patronising.
